cases.name: chinook_validation_nested_invoice_lines
cases.reason: Carries invoice lines through two CTE and derived-table scopes before grouping customer totals; join, grouping, filter, and aggregate inputs remain reads.
cases.sql: WITH invoice_lines AS (SELECT il.InvoiceId AS invoice_id, il.TrackId AS track_id, CASE WHEN il.Quantity >= 2 THEN il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity ELSE 0 END AS billed_amount FROM InvoiceLine AS il), customer_lines AS (SELECT i.CustomerId AS customer_id, c.Country AS country, l.track_id, l.billed_amount FROM Invoice AS i JOIN invoice_lines AS l ON l.invoice_id = i.InvoiceId JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId) SELECT customer_id, country, SUM(billed_amount) AS bulk_revenue, COUNT(track_id) AS billed_tracks FROM (SELECT customer_id, country, track_id, billed_amount FROM customer_lines) AS report GROUP BY customer_id, country HAVING SUM(billed_amount) > 0 ORDER BY bulk_revenue DESC, country

cases.name: chinook_validation_customer_labels
cases.reason: Builds a display label with COALESCE and classifies left-joined customers with CASE while preserving join and filter columns as reads.
cases.sql: SELECT c.CustomerId AS customer_id, COALESCE(c.Company, c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName) AS display_name, CASE WHEN i.InvoiceId IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE 'invoiced' END AS billing_status FROM Customer AS c LEFT JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country IS NOT NULL ORDER BY display_name

cases.name: chinook_validation_intersect_playlist_tracks
cases.reason: Intersects genre-selected catalog tracks with playlist membership, so both set-operation output sources and the genre predicate are dependencies.
cases.sql: SELECT t.TrackId AS track_id FROM Track AS t WHERE t.GenreId IN (1, 3, 13) INTERSECT SELECT pt.TrackId AS track_id FROM PlaylistTrack AS pt

cases.name: chinook_validation_genre_media_summary
cases.reason: Groups tracks by genre and media type, retaining both join and group keys as reads while exposing count and conditional price lineage.
cases.sql: SELECT g.Name AS genre_name, m.Name AS media_type, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.UnitPrice >= 1.00 THEN t.UnitPrice ELSE 0 END) AS premium_value FROM Track AS t JOIN Genre AS g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name, m.MediaTypeId, m.Name HAVING COUNT(t.TrackId) > 0 ORDER BY premium_value DESC, genre_name

cases.name: chinook_validation_artist_rollup
cases.reason: Uses correlated scalar subqueries for album existence, album count, and maximum track duration; COUNT(*) has no value source while the maximum carries track duration lineage.
cases.sql: SELECT a.ArtistId AS artist_id, a.Name AS artist_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album AS al WHERE al.ArtistId = a.ArtistId) AS album_count, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(t.Milliseconds), 0) FROM Album AS al JOIN Track AS t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId WHERE al.ArtistId = a.ArtistId) AS max_track_ms FROM Artist AS a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Album AS al WHERE al.ArtistId = a.ArtistId) ORDER BY max_track_ms DESC, artist_name

cases.name: chinook_validation_genre_duration_rank
cases.reason: Ranks tracks within each genre; the window partition and ordering columns are value lineage, and the price predicate remains a read dependency.
cases.sql: SELECT t.GenreId AS genre_id, t.Name AS track_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.GenreId ORDER BY t.Milliseconds DESC) AS duration_rank FROM Track AS t WHERE t.UnitPrice >= 0.99 ORDER BY t.GenreId, duration_rank

cases.name: chinook_validation_customer_spend_segment
cases.reason: Aggregates invoices in a CTE and labels left-joined customers with COALESCE and CASE; invoice totals feed both the amount and segment lineage.
cases.sql: WITH customer_spend AS (SELECT i.CustomerId AS customer_id, SUM(i.Total) AS total_spend FROM Invoice AS i GROUP BY i.CustomerId) SELECT c.CustomerId AS customer_id, COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) AS total_spend, CASE WHEN s.total_spend IS NULL THEN 'new' WHEN s.total_spend >= 100 THEN 'vip' ELSE 'standard' END AS segment FROM Customer AS c LEFT JOIN customer_spend AS s ON s.customer_id = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Email IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_spend DESC

cases.name: chinook_validation_employee_manager_status
cases.reason: Left-joins each employee to an optional manager and derives both a fallback manager label and a role from nullable reporting metadata.
cases.sql: SELECT e.EmployeeId AS staff_id, COALESCE(m.FirstName || ' ' || m.LastName, 'Unassigned') AS manager_name, CASE WHEN e.ReportsTo IS NULL THEN 'leader' ELSE 'staff' END AS role FROM Employee AS e LEFT JOIN Employee AS m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo WHERE e.HireDate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY manager_name, staff_id
